final: WITH m AS (SELECT mt.Name AS Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL)/t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bpms) AS overall FROM m) SELECT m.Name, m.avg_bpms, m.avg_bpms - o.overall AS diff_above_overall FROM m, o WHERE m.avg_bpms > o.overall
